Context: Major Penalties.-

Based on a reference from an inquiring authority, seeking the issuance of a notification by the Central Government/Competent Authority under Section 4 of the Departmental Enquiries (Enforcement of Attendance of Witnesses and Production of Documents) Act, 1972, the Inquiry Officer is empowered to exercise powers of Civil Court for enforcement of attendance of witness and production of documents. - GID (52), Rule 14.
